note: Model-specific categorization for crates/mlx-affine/examples/header_census.rs. It lives here, above the neutral crates, because a tensor-name prefix means nothing to safetensors-catalog or mlx-affine and must not start meaning something to them. The census runs without this file and simply reports no groups. Groups may overlap and are counts, not a partition; the census also reports every tensor no group matched. The `vision` group is unchanged from the 1.0.0 file used by Slice 1; the other groups were added for the Slice 2A census, derived from the checkpoint's shard headers and config.json, and say which. Expectations only make the census report a surprise; classification comes from mlx-affine's Slice 1 rules alone.
applies_to: PipeNetwork GLM-5.3-Flash-MLX-mixed-4_8bit and the same family

groups.name: vision
groups.why: The conversion recipe excludes the vision tower, so every tensor under this prefix is carried through as stored. Anything else under it is worth reporting.

groups.name: norms
groups.basis: headers: layer, attention, indexer, output and vision normalization parameters

groups.name: router
groups.basis: headers: mlp.gate.weight and mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias in MoE layers; config n_routed_experts 288, scoring_func sigmoid, moe_router_dtype float32. The trailing dot keeps gate_proj out.

groups.name: router_correction_bias
groups.basis: headers: F32 [288] per MoE layer; config topk_method noaux_tc

groups.name: routed_experts
groups.basis: headers: switch_mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj stacked with a leading expert dimension; config n_routed_experts 288, moe_intermediate_size 2048

groups.name: dense_mlp
groups.basis: headers: mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj directly under a language-model layer; config first_k_dense_replace 3. The prefix keeps the vision tower's mlp, which the vision group reports, out.

groups.name: mla_attention
groups.basis: headers: MLA projections in the deepseek_sparse_attention layers; config linear_attn_config.full_attn_layers (11 layers), q_lora_rank 1536, kv_lora_rank 512

groups.name: linear_attention
groups.basis: headers: the linear-attention members; config linear_attn_config.kda_layers (34 layers), num_heads 64, head_dim 128, short_conv_kernel_size 4

groups.name: attention_output
groups.basis: headers: o_proj in every language-model layer, with two in_features depending on the attention type

groups.name: indexer
groups.basis: headers: indexer members in the sparse-attention layers only; config index_n_heads 32, index_head_dim 128, index_kpool 4, index_kpool_compress true. No expectation: whether the indexer is quantized is what the census reports.

groups.name: hyper_connections
groups.basis: headers: attn_hc/ffn_hc {fn,base,scale}; config text_config.mhc true, hc_mult 4, hc_sinkhorn_iters 20

groups.name: mtp
groups.basis: config num_nextn_predict_layers 1 with num_hidden_layers 45: a next-token-prediction layer would be layer index 45. Expected absent from this MLX conversion; a match is reported.
